studies.comparison_type: Highest versus lowest quartile of dietary polyunsaturated fat intake (quartile 4 versus quartile 1), for high-grade prostate cancer (Gleason score 8–10)
studies.exposure_measurement_supporting_text: Nutrient intake was assessed using a food frequency questionnaire and a structured supplement-use questionnaire.

sample_size.excerpt: The authors examined nutritional risk factors for prostate cancer among 9,559 participants in the Prostate Cancer Prevention Trial (United States and Canada, 1994-2003).

cases.excerpt: Cancer was detected in 1,703 men; 127 cancers were high-grade (Gleason score 8-10).
